**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The AUDIT rule is satisfied because the Agreement contains **no audit right running against us (PB)** at all:

- **Art. 9 (p0624–p0625)** — mutual record-*keeping* and retention obligations only (GAAP accounting records; Development books and records "in sufficient detail to verify compliance"). No access, inspection or examination right attaches.
- **§ 3.6 (p0321–p0322)** — mutual quality-oversight audits of each Party's own *Permitted Third Parties*, and PB's audits of the Product manufacturing facilities, with report-sharing. SFJ audits PB's vendors' facilities, not PB itself.
- **§ 3.5.5 (p0318), § 5.4.4.3 (p0453), § 3.18.2 (p0367)** — report-sharing, Governmental Authority inspection notification, and financial-statement reporting respectively; none is an audit right over us.
- Searches for inspection/examination/verification/access/business-hours language returned nothing conferring SFJ entry to our premises, records or systems.

With no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access term to constrain, our position is better than the preferred one, so inserting audit parameters would only create exposure. Noted in the rationale (not flagged): the § 9.2 phrase "in sufficient detail to verify compliance" should not be argued into an implied access right, and if SFJ later requests an express audit right we would hold to the preferred limits — once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor under confidentiality, SFJ's cost absent >5% underpayment, no system access.
